items.exampleEn: You can apply for a library card at the front desk.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在服務台申請借書證。

items.exampleEn: The washing machine broke down again this morning.
items.exampleZh: 洗衣機今天早上又故障了。

items.exampleEn: Someone broke into the empty house last night.
items.exampleZh: 昨晚有人闖入那間空屋。

items.exampleEn: Our company must work harder to catch up with other companies.
items.exampleZh: 我們公司必須更努力，才能趕上其他公司。

items.exampleEn: Cheer up! You will do better next time.
items.exampleZh: 打起精神來！你下次會做得更好。

items.exampleEn: I came across an interesting shop near the station.
items.exampleZh: 我在車站附近偶然發現一家很有趣的店。

items.exampleEn: Our office is trying to cut down on paper.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦公室正在努力減少用紙。

items.sentenceEn: My grandpa's old radio finally broke down after thirty years.
items.sentenceZh: 爺爺的舊收音機用了三十年，終於壞了。

items.audioEn: While I was cleaning my room, I came across a letter from my grandfather.
items.audioZh: 我在整理房間的時候，偶然發現一封爺爺寫的信。
items.questionZh: 說話的人整理房間時發生了什麼事？
options: Lost a letter from a classmate

items.sentenceEn: Let's take her out for dinner to cheer her up.
items.sentenceZh: 我們帶她出去吃晚餐，讓她開心一點吧。

items.sentenceEn: Our cat broke into the kitchen cupboard and ate the fish.
items.sentenceZh: 我們家的貓闖進廚房的櫥櫃，把魚吃掉了。

items.stemEn: Our family wants to ____ screen time.
items.stemZh: 我們家想減少看螢幕的時間。

items.stemEn: Our car ____ on the way to the beach.
items.stemZh: 我們的車在去海邊的路上拋錨了。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, Mia ran in a long race in her town. At the start, she ran too fast and soon got tired. Many runners passed her, and she felt like giving up. Then she came across her best friend, Ken, at the side of the road. "You can do it!" he shouted. That really cheered her up. She slowly caught up with the runners in front of her and finished the race with a big smile.
items.passageZh: 上星期天，Mia 在她住的鎮上參加一場長跑比賽。一開始她跑得太快，很快就累了。很多跑者超過她，她很想放棄。後來她在路邊遇到她最好的朋友 Ken。「你做得到！」他大喊。這句話真的讓她打起了精神。她慢慢趕上跑在前面的人，帶著燦爛的笑容跑完了比賽。

questions.questionZh: Mia 一開始為什麼很想放棄？
是誰讓 Mia 打起精神？

items.promptZh: 我哥哥上個月申請了一份新工作。
referenceEn: My brother applied for a new job last month.
Last month, my older brother applied for a new job.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 applied for 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 sent in an application 等）也算對
上個月的事用過去式（例如 applied for、sent 等）
「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother 等

items.promptZh: 你先走，我等一下會趕上你。
referenceEn: You go first. I'll catch up with you later.
Go ahead. I will catch up with you later.
You can go first, and I will catch up with you soon.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 catch up with you 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 catch up、join you later 等）也算對
「等一下」表示稍後，例如 later、soon 等
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、'll 等）
「你先走」可寫，例如 You go first、Go ahead 等
